title: pvGenerateIds
body:
## pvGenerateIds

Deprecated alias of pvPointAndCellIds: ParaView 5.13 marks GenerateIdScalars for removal in 5.14, and it still runs the older vtkIdFilter. It adds zero-based point indices (PointIds) and cell indices (CellIds) as point and cell arrays. Use pvPointAndCellIds or generateIds in new workflows.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- This identifier is expected to disappear when ParaView 5.14 is absorbed.
- Ids restart in every block and MPI piece; use pvGlobalPointAndCellIds for global ids.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GenerateIds`. Identity: `filters/GenerateIdScalars`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Data to Point Data filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellIdsArrayName` | The name of the cell ids array. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `GenerateCellIds` | Enable generation of cell ids. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GeneratePointIds` | Enable generation of point ids. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PointIdsArrayName` | The name of the point ids array. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGenerateIds",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
